name: Traffic race co-op (build 2)
author: shahariar07
description: Have some update on this build. Now The game has winner condition. Any player touch first the winner obsticle win. Also now if a player get his way out of border GameOver pop out. Also now the traffic is random spawn from different position and distroy when out of the game area. Its a lcoal co-op game.Player can individualy control different vichele. Player 1 can be controlled with w,a,s,d keys and player 2 can be controlled with arrow keys. Also there is different camera view for different player. Player 1 can be toggle between his camera view with "C" button press and Player 2 also can with "V" button press. Thank you
